name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.118.0 — The ```surfaces line grammar is parsed in exactly one place, `spec/scripts/lib/surfaces.js`, and `design-atlas.js` and `genesis-driver.js` both fold over it instead of carrying divergent copies; `genesis-driver.js` also drops its own synchronous stdout writer and fail-closed child runner for `lib/driver-io.js`, matching the review, build, and mocks drivers. Behavior is unchanged and both drivers shrink. 7.117.0 — Driver-stepped command files (build, review, run, mocks) stop restating what their drivers print at runtime — every envelope, exit, cap and remedy now arrives from the driver at the step where it is needed, once. Every command's Rules section is capped at 8 bullets and every shared-for section list is pinned exactly, so a section cannot join a command's read surface silently. The host pipeline-rules file is documented as path-scoped and arrives with the config Read, so no command re-reads it, and the genesis discovery brief is edited in place per answer and rendered in full only once, at discovery's end. 7.116.0 — The four hand-rolled "does this page apply the wireframe register" checks across design-atlas.js and mocks-driver.js now share one derivation, spec/scripts/lib/wire-register.js, which reads a page's applied stylesheets — link tags with a stylesheet rel in any quoting form or attribute order, plus CSS @import, comments stripped — and answers whether any target has wire as a whole path segment, fixing a register applied through @import being read as unstyled and a deleted-but-commented register link being read as drawn.
